speaker: Doctor
text: Can you describe the appearance of the rash on your palms and when you first noticed it? Have you experienced any similar symptoms in other parts of your body?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your exposure to livestock and rice paddies, have you noticed any dark-colored, granular grains in the soil or on your skin, and do you have any difficulty moving your hands or feet, such as foot drop or weakness in your forearms? REQUEST TEST: Skin Biopsy

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Chronic inflammatory cells with features suggestive of leprosy.

speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy results strongly suggest leprosy, specifically a form that affects the nerves. Do you have any areas of numbness on your face or trunk, and have you noticed any loss of eyebrows or eyelashes?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text: The presence of hypopigmented macules, eyebrow loss, and nerve involvement confirms a diagnosis of leprosy. DIAGNOSIS READY: Tuberculoid Leprosy
